mainText: <speak><voice name="Salli">Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees and overcast by Harriet Park, and we are currently under a full moon.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">The City Clerk is looking for student designs for an I Voted sticker contest to be used in the November election. Also, if you want to participate in the tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center, please ensure your waiver is signed and turned in.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">We have a busy day of events with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the downtown farmer's market and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">Looking at the weekly police report, on July 26, a 55 year old woman was arrested for her first O W I offence after being clocked at 97 miles per hour on the highway.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Ivy">Today's delicious Flavor of the Day is Georgia Peach. The shop is currently closed, but they open up at 10 AM, so get ready to head over and grab a treat.</voice></speak>
